estimand: transport of a construction-fitted nuisance-quotiented content-versus-label response contrast to behavior families absent from the calibration registry

calibration.calibration_rule: The center is the mean of the 12 construction scenario means. The radius is the maximum absolute construction-scenario residual from that center. The common coefficient interval is the exact intersection already sealed by v0.68 construction. None is refit on v0.82.

gates.N0: The manifest has exactly 12 new family labels disjoint from v0.68, exactly one executed holdout per family, and an exact registered 528-record universe.
gates.I0: Exact repeats, rendered inputs, answer-token boundaries, and zero-sum quotient coefficient controls pass.
gates.L0: At least 10 of 12 new scenarios have all four target-by-order specificity contrasts above the v0.82 endpoint epsilon, and the median scenario minimum and mean scenario mean also exceed epsilon.
gates.T0: At least 10 of 12 new scenario-mean specificity values lie in the frozen construction prediction envelope [0.5208333500971378, 1.3554687239229698].
gates.G0: All 24 target-specific new-family intervals, formed from their two display orders plus the v0.82 endpoint epsilon, intersect the frozen construction common-coefficient interval [0.7343614199407966, 0.750013550256881].
gates.R0: The hard-capped runner completes all registered work units and emits a cleanup receipt; process-owned resource violations invalidate execution. System-wide page-file movement is reported but is not attributed to the owned process and is not a scientific gate.

claim_boundary: This can establish transport of one expressed-response contrast across 12 prospectively frozen, previously absent behavior families in one model. It cannot identify human or model values, show that prompt content supplies naturally known intervention offsets, identify a reward orbit, establish population generalization, authorize self-modification, or resolve ASMP-9.
